messages:
Priya R: Kicking off Lighthouse Health POC. They want server-side streaming + function/tool calls + strict JSON schema output. Also require SAML SSO (Okta), KMS, and EU-only storage. Need a short runbook + security answers + rough pricing for ~100k tokens/day. Can eng/devex help? @Alex M @Samir K
Alex M: I can draft the runbook. Quick clarifying q: server-side Node process or browser client for streaming? Auth flow differs.
Priya R: Server-side Node app. Prefer SSE with a webhook fallback for occasional drops. They may opt for reserved capacity later.
Samir K: For Node server we recommend ephemeral delegated tokens + SSE. Minimal example below (pseudo):
```js
// create ephemeral token on backend (1h TTL)
const resp = await fetch('/ephemeral-token')
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: resp.token })
const stream = client.stream.generate({ model: 'r-instruct-1', streaming: true })
stream.on('message', (m) => console.log(m))
stream.on('tool_call', (call) => {
  // run tool in sandbox and send result back
  const result = runTool(call.name, call.args)
  stream.sendToolResult({ id: call.id, result })
})
```
Samir K: Important patterns: 1) sandbox tool execution with strict timeouts, 2) log tool inputs/outputs to audit bucket, 3) validation on tool results before returning to model.
Marina L: For structured JSON output we strongly prefer function-calling + schema enforcement. On parse failure return a structured error (field-level hints) rather than best-effort text. Also add a post-processing validation step in their ETL to reject malformed records.
Alex M: Security notes: SAML for console SSO is standard. For API usage -> ephemeral tokens minted by a backend service using org-level service principal. IP allowlist supported at org level. KMS: BYOK via provider integrations supported on Hosted for envelope encryption; full HSM-backed key management and attestation is only on Dedicated/Private. EU residency: Hosted can pin region for data-in-transit and storage but for contractual residency + audit logs recommend Dedicated.
deploy-bot: POC workspace created: lighthouse-health-poc-eu (owner: priya.r). Services provisioned: sse-gateway, ephemeral-token-service, audit-log-bucket.
Priya R: Great. Can someone draft SQA responses for KMS/HSM wording and data residency guarantees? I attached their questionnaire in CRM.
Samir K: I'll draft SDK/streaming/fn-call answers and a short demo script (Node + Postman) showing ephemeral token flow and how to handle tool callbacks. Will include the minimal runbook steps.
Finance Bot: Ballpark pricing notes (non-binding): Hosted POC ~0.0006 USD per token (example) => ~60 USD/day for 100k tokens (note: includes model & infra). Dedicated monthly commit for similar sustained throughput with EU residency: expect starting commits in mid five-figures/month. I'll coordinate a more precise estimate if you share expected concurrency and latency SLOs.
Marina L: Thanks. I'll follow up with finance for a tighter estimate and drop it here. Also recommend we prepare a short slide for procurement with Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs (cost, SLA, residency, KMS/HSM).
Alex M: Runbook sketch (high level):
- 1) Create ephemeral service token (TTL 1h) via backend (minted with org service principal)
- 2) Server opens SSE stream to sse-gateway using token
- 3) On tool_call events, run tool in sandboxed worker (cpu/memory limits) and return result via stream.sendToolResult
- 4) Use json_schema param in generate call to require fields; reject/annotate on parse errors
- 5) Audit: write tool inputs/outputs and model responses to audit-log-bucket (encrypted with customer KMS envelope)
- 6) For Prod/EU residency: plan Dedicated migration, HSM option, and SOC2/ISO evidence bundle
Alex M: I'll prepare SQA text for KMS + residency clauses and list what proofs we can provide (SOC2 report, encryption at rest details, audit log retention).
Priya R: Can we target a technical sync Wed 10am PT with their infra lead? I'll send invite. Also we need the runbook + SQA draft before that.
Samir K: Ack. I'll post the runbook + demo assets here ~T-1h before the sync.
Marina L: I'll post the finance estimate and a one-pager on Hosted vs Dedicated tradeoffs before the sync.
Priya R: Assigning owners: Samir -> runbook/demo/SQA draft (SDK + streaming), Alex -> infra/KMS/residency SQA, Marina/Finance -> pricing estimate. Will follow up after sync. :thumbsup:
